The following called meeting
having been Advertised ten days by Posters being put up in various portions of the City.
Called Meeting of the City Council
May the 16th 1876
Called for the purpose of hearing Complaints and receiving Tax Roll. Present His Honor the
Mayor in the Chair. The Roll called Aldermen present, Aldermen
Palen, Gonschke, Collins and Fox, Rolls examined, No complaints made, Some corrections of
errors were considered necessary, which His Honor the Mayor agreed to have made, Otherwise
the Rolls were approved

a O. Stone
Recorder
